title: A point unramified in a locally finite type morphism is isolated in its fibre
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $x\in X$, put $s=f(x)$, and write $\kappa(s)$ for the residue field [def-weil-residue-field]. Assume that $f$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and unramified at $x$: there is an open neighbourhood $X'\subseteq X$ of $x$ (an open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion]) such that the restriction $f|_{X'}:X'\to S$ is unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism] (this is Stacks, Morphisms, Definition 02G4 (1), and already implies that $f$ is locally of finite type near $x$). Let $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ be the scheme-theoretic fibre with first projection $p:X_s\to X$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre], and let $\xi\in X_s$ be the unique point with $p(\xi)=x$. Then $\{\xi\}$ is open in $X_s$ (so $\xi$ is an isolated point of $X_s$). Equivalently, $\{x\}$ is open in the subspace $f^{-1}(s)$ of $X$. (Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma 02G7 (lemma-unramified-over-field), part (2), applied to an unramified neighbourhood of $x$; compare Lemma 02GF (lemma-unramified-at-point) and Lemma 02V5 (lemma-unramified-quasi-finite).)

source.place: Morphisms, Definition 02G4 (definition-unramified, line 7616), Lemma 02G7 (lemma-unramified-over-field, lines 7790-7826) with Lemma 02GA (lemma-base-change-unramified, line 7718); related: Lemma 02GF (lemma-unramified-at-point, lines 7875-7930), Lemma 02V5 (lemma-unramified-quasi-finite, lines 7779-7788)

proof.text: Choose the open neighbourhood $X'\subseteq X$ of $x$ with $f':=f|_{X'}:X'\to S$ unramified. Let $\sigma:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$ be the canonical morphism and $X'_s=X'\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ the fibre of $f'$ over $s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre], with second projection $q':X'_s\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$; $q'$ is the base change of $f'$ along $\sigma$. By clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-base-change-open] (with $g=\sigma$), $q'$ is unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism].

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G7, proof (line 7804: part (2) follows from part (1) and Lemma 02GA), Lemma 02GA (line 7718)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-over-field-discrete] to the field $k=\kappa(s)$ and the unramified morphism $q':X'_s\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ of step 1: every point of $X'_s$ is open in $X'_s$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G7, part (1) and proof (lines 7806-7820: all points of an unramified scheme over a field are isolated, so it is discrete)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product] to $f:X\to S$, $\sigma:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$ and the open subschemes $V=X'\subseteq X$, $W=\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$, $U=S$ (so $f(V)\subseteq U$, $\sigma(W)\subseteq U$): the canonical morphism $j:X'_s=X'\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)=X_s$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] with image the open set $p^{-1}(X')$, compatibly with the projections, so $p\circ j=\iota\circ p'$ where $p':X'_s\to X'$ is the first projection and $\iota:X'\hookrightarrow X$ the inclusion.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma 01JR (schemes-lemma-open-fibre-product), as recorded in lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product

proof.text: Since $p(\xi)=x\in X'$, the point $\xi$ lies in the open set $p^{-1}(X')=j(X'_s)$; write $\xi=j(\xi')$ with $\xi'\in X'_s$. By step 2 the set $\{\xi'\}$ is open in $X'_s$; an open immersion is an open map onto an open subset, so $\{\xi\}=j(\{\xi'\})$ is open in $X_s$ (step 3). Finally, by [def-pc-scheme-fibre] the projection $p$ is a homeomorphism of $X_s$ onto the subspace $f^{-1}(s)$ of $X$; it carries $\xi$ to $x$ and the open set $\{\xi\}$ to the open set $\{x\}$ of $f^{-1}(s)$ (and conversely), which is the equivalent form of the statement. (The point $\xi$ is unique for the same reason.)

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G7, part (2), lines 7797-7799 (the fibre of an unramified morphism is a disjoint union of spectra of fields, hence discrete), applied to the unramified neighbourhood $X'$

proof_origin.place: Morphisms, Lemma 02G7 (lemma-unramified-over-field), part (2) and its proof (lines 7790-7826), applied to an unramified open neighbourhood of x (Definition 02G4 (1))

Statement corrected: def-weil-unramified-morphism has no pointwise notion, so 'unramified at x' is now stated explicitly as Stacks 02G4 (1) (an open neighbourhood X' with f|X' unramified), as the citer lem-weil-pbc-unramified-etale-local-decomposition uses it; the point xi of X_s over x is named; the tag citation is corrected: the discreteness of fibres of unramified morphisms is 02G7 (lemma-unramified-over-field) part (2), not 02G8 (lemma-unramified-etale-fibres, which is about residue fields and the converse); def-weil-open-immersion added to stmt_deps for the open subscheme. The locally-finite-type hypothesis is kept though redundant near x. Proof in four steps following the proof of 02G7: base change of the unramified neighbourhood to the fibre (lem-weil-pbc-unramified-base-change-open, unsplit), discreteness of a scheme unramified over a field (new node lem-weil-pbc-unramified-over-field-discrete, 02G7 (1)), the fibre of X' as the open p^{-1}(X') of X_s (lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product, a Mathlib leaf), and the elementary transfer via the homeomorphism X_s -> f^{-1}(s) of def-pc-scheme-fibre.

lean.statement: theorem unramified_fibre_point_isolated {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X) (h_unramified : ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ (LocallyOfFiniteType (U.ι ≫ f) ∧ IsOpenImmersion (pullback.diagonal (U.ι ≫ f)))) : IsOpen ({f.asFiber x} : Set (f.fiber (f x))) ∧ (∀ ξ : f.fiber (f x), f.fiberι (f x) ξ = x → ξ = f.asFiber x) ∧ IsOpen ({⟨x, rfl⟩} : Set (f ⁻¹' {f x}))
